nodes.label: SEPED Login Page Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Representative snapshot of the SEPED (Sistema de Pedidos Droguería Intercontinental) external pharmacy ordering web app login page. 22 identical-structure snapshots exist across two date ranges: 2026-09-04T21:40 to 2026-09-04T21:46, and 2026-09-05T02:50 to 2026-09-05T03:01, captured approximately every minute. Structure: Bootstrap 3 HTML form with email/password fields, CSRF token meta tag, POST action to /login, uses SEPED app.css + electro-master Bootstrap/Slick/noUISlider/Font-Awesome CSS stack, Montserrat Google Font, styleCelesteVerde.css theme. Links back to drogueriaintercontinental.com. Each snapshot has a unique CSRF token value indicating live captures.

nodes.label: Módulo BackOffice
nodes.rationale: Administration module present since v1.2.0. Hosts permission panel, changelog modal (v1.2.7), rollback/restore UI (v1.2.7), FTP_SERVIDOR management (v1.2.6), configurable timezone and branding (v1.2.5/v1.2.6).

nodes.label: Módulo FTP Servidor
nodes.rationale: Embedded FTP server module introduced in v1.2.6. Manages FTP users, automatic inventory+invoice cycle, Excel with D1%/D2%, FTP_SERVIDOR module in BackOffice, mass user import from Excel. ORDERID uses prefix F (not FP). Automatically imports orders with type separation (P/NI/SD/normal).

nodes.label: Módulo iCompras / Ecommerce
nodes.rationale: Ecommerce integration in Control de Estatus introduced in v1.2.3. Splits orders into P/NI/SD/normal groups; separates psychotropic orders. In v1.2.5: import errors visible in UI, resolve by direct CODARTICULO, consolidate duplicate lines, full audit trail, uses seller from CLIENTESCAMPOSLIBRES, America/Caracas timezone.

nodes.label: Módulo Metas de Vendedores
nodes.rationale: Sales targets dashboard introduced in v1.2.7. Syncs with [RIP].[METAS_VENDEDORES]; tracks progress and rankings; targets in USD; seller selector by code or name; auto-sync CUMPLIDA status.

nodes.label: Módulo Rutero de Entrega
nodes.rationale: Delivery routing module with APP_RUTEROS tables in a separate DB. Features: barcode picking, EN_RUTA/ENTREGADO states, picking session by user, exclusive lock, PDF with boxes and logo, date filtering, RUTERO_ADMIN permission (bit 65536) for advanced operations, audit logging. Introduced in v1.2.3, expanded through v1.2.8.

nodes.label: Sistema de Permisos Bitmask (VISIBILIDAD)
nodes.rationale: Permission system using VISIBILIDAD bitmask introduced in v1.2.2. Managed via BackOffice panel. Permission bits: DESCUENTO_LINEA=512, RUTERO_ADMIN=65536. VISIBILIDAD limit expanded to INT max to support >15 modules. Total access calculated dynamically from MODULOS table (not hardcoded to 32767).

nodes.label: Version 1.2.0 (Initial commit)
nodes.rationale: Base project: Pedidos Droguería Intercontinental v1.2 with Catálogo, Carrito, Control de Estatus, Edición de Pedidos and BackOffice modules.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.1 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14)
nodes.rationale: Authentication from DROGUERIA..VENDEDORES on ports 9000/9010; GitHub API updater without git; D1 global client discount from CLIENTESCAMPOSLIBRES; lot/expiry in PDFs.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.2 (2026-06-15 to 2026-06-30)
nodes.rationale: Bitmask permission system (VISIBILIDAD), IVA per article in cart/PDF/DB, catalog segments by D1 client discount, Status Control filters, manual discount in order editing, promotions with include/exclude groups, auto-update with backup/NSSM.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.3 (2026-07-01 to 2026-07-09)
nodes.rationale: Base Rutero de Entrega module with APP_RUTEROS tables in separate DB; ecommerce/iCompras integration; batch invoice printing module; psychotropic orders with PDF formats; catalog improvements.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.4 (2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13)
nodes.rationale: Complete delivery Rutero with barcode picking, EN_RUTA status, PDF with boxes and logo; fixed pagination 'All' option, invoice billing mark via ALBVENTACAB.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.5 (2026-07-14 to 2026-07-19)
nodes.rationale: Icompras reliability improvements, white-label branding, generalized picking session, DESCUENTO_LINEA permission (bit 512), AUTORIZADOR permission for psychotropic orders, rutero audit logging, FTP automatic order import, and NOLOCK concurrency fix.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.6 (2026-07-20 to 2026-07-27)
nodes.rationale: Full FTP server module with user management and automatic inventory+invoice cycle, new catalog Excel layout, Reclamos module with ALBVENTACAB/ALBVENTALIN, supplier/brand promotions, configurable timezone, and 4-hour UTC date offset correction.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.7 (2026-07-27 to 2026-07-29)
nodes.rationale: Introduces Metas de Vendedores dashboard, rollback system, changelog modal in admin, seller selector in order editing, invoice number/series in status control, and PDF format selector.

nodes.label: Version 1.2.8 (2026-07-30)
nodes.rationale: Adds RUTERO_ADMIN permission (bit 65536), date filters in Rutero module (Desde/Hasta), confirmation button lock when not EN_RUTA, NODTOAPLICABLE discount suppression bug fix, and duplicate invoice prevention in concurrent ruteros.
